title: Eton Mess Pudding
description: A classic British dessert made with chocolate mousse and fresh berries, perfect for warm weather.
instructions: In a double boiler, melt the chocolate over low heat.
In a separate bowl, whip the double cream until stiff peaks form.
In another bowl, whisk the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Add the granulated sugar to the egg whites and continue whisking until stiff and glossy.
Fold the whipped cream into the melted chocolate until well combined.
Fold the egg white mixture into the chocolate mixture until well combined.
Spoon the mixture into individual serving cups.
Top each serving with fresh berries.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.
